states.checked: a current focused client record for this module and language passed, and nothing current failed
states.available: a handwritten client or a generated service interface exists, and no current check is recorded
states.types: generated record types only; no handwritten client or generated service interface
states.failed: a current focused record, or the module tests at the current source, failed
states.none: no source for this module in this language

rules.test_connection: the cell is checked, and none of its passing client records ran over the connection named by transport "shared-native-ipc"
rules.failed_before: the cell has no current verdict, and its module tests or an earlier_checks record failed at an earlier source
rules.earlier_checks: focused records whose declared inputs changed after they ran; history only, they set no state
rules.module_tests.last.tree: Git tree hash of the module directory the module tests measured (git rev-parse HEAD:<module path>)
rules.module_tests.condition: "local changes", "uncommitted run" or "darwin peer proof" when one applies, else null

capabilities.name: facade
capabilities.description: Resolve a capability through one local OA service while providers and service locations can change.

capabilities.name: Durable jobs
capabilities.description: Submit work once, save its identity and observe, cancel or recover the same accepted work.

capabilities.name: Verified downloads
capabilities.description: Describe an artifact once and let a job provider acquire, verify and deliver it.
capabilities.types_note: Submit a download as a Durable job with these records.

capabilities.name: Settings
capabilities.description: Read effective OA settings, their sources, revisioned edits and later changes.

capabilities.name: Named credentials
capabilities.description: Keep secret bytes with the credential manager and let approved services apply them to specific requests.

capabilities.name: Structured events
capabilities.description: Write common events and let authorized tools read saved events or follow new ones.

capabilities.name: Shared content
capabilities.description: Find bytes by content fingerprint, then read, write and watch them for changes within size limits.

capabilities.name: Watch
capabilities.description: Turn polled or pushed values into current snapshots, quiet notices, or one callback after a burst settles.

capabilities.name: Permissions
capabilities.description: Decide and administer which verified programs may use each capability or operator action.

capabilities.name: Questions
capabilities.description: Pause a specific action and ask the responsible person for a decision.

capabilities.name: Caller identity
capabilities.description: Use the operating system connection to identify the local program and account for permission decisions.

capabilities.name: Model inference
capabilities.description: Use chat, embeddings, speech, transcription, live voice and images; retain video and image-batch work as durable jobs.

capabilities.name: Model lookup
capabilities.description: Resolve model names and provider metadata through a shared model vocabulary.

capabilities.name: Model router
capabilities.description: Declare model servers and select eligible providers from requirements and operator policy.

capabilities.name: Resources
capabilities.description: See who holds graphics-card and system memory, reserve an amount with a lease and keep the machine awake with a wake lease.

capabilities.name: Atomic file
capabilities.description: Compare-and-set (CAS): a development utility that compares and replaces bytes only when their recorded value still matches.
